projects.title: Managed File Transfer (MFT) Platform
projects.summary: Designed and developed a secure, event-driven enterprise MFT platform integrated with AWS and Kubernetes for automating complex file workflows in regulated environments.
projects.description: Led the architecture and implementation of a comprehensive cloud-native MFT system that handles enterprise-scale file processing with strict compliance requirements.
responsibilities: Designed modular Spring StateMachine engine enabling dynamic, pluggable workflows driven by metadata and rules from external microservices
Implemented ZIP/BZIP2 compression and PGP encryption with public-private key model for end-to-end file confidentiality
Built flexible regex-based file renaming with custom patterns supporting date/time, time zones, and metadata placeholders
Integrated AWS GuardDuty for malware scanning with quarantining and notifications for suspicious files
Developed automated file hygiene conversions (Unix↔DOS, EBCDIC↔ASCII) as reusable StateMachine actions
impact: Engineered streaming-based multipart upload system for reliable transfer of gigabyte-scale files
Built fully non-blocking Spring WebFlux REST API for workflow orchestration
Integrated DAG Scheduler for automated file ingestion event detection and workflow triggering
Deployed as dedicated EKS pods with dynamic pod information capture for distributed coordination
